findings.title: UI recovery assumes a stronger private schema than the store
findings.reproduction: writeDrafts and readDrafts accept {id:broken,versions:[{}]}. In an isolated A browser, opening Private workspace throws Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length); no workspace renders. Public/private bytes remain unchanged.
findings.fix: Validate the UI recovery envelope and version fields defensively. Show recovery-unavailable and preserve bytes, pending text and invalid plots; do not silently discard/normalize.

findings.title: Diagnostics lose the exact engine rejection rule

findings.fix: Add an allowlisted validator-rule field retaining area_capacity versus site_capacity_exceeded through diagnostics and export, without private values.
